study.description: The Namesake Task 1: how many of a species' drawn sound-change rules actually fire, over 200 unselected worlds. Answers whether the seed-42 observation (goblin 0/70, hobgoblin 0/74, kobold 0/78 words changed) is general or a one-seed artifact.
